notes.title: Monthly Transmission Manifest (May 2025) - Redesign The Card (Frame)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2a170c75263970abf461d05a67fa6de48aee332e.png[/img]

[h1]This is the commander speaking! [/h1]

Welcome to May devlog for Mini Tank Mayhem! Our visual department has been busy overhaul the visual of the game. From tweaking the level until redesign the card frame.
 
Don’t forget to always check out our videos and posts on [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61566488172517]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/minitankmayhem/]Instagram [/url], and [url=https://x.com/MiniTankMayhem]Twitter[/url]. Now let's get those tanks moving! 

[h2]Designing The First Card [/h2]

In any deckbuilder game, card design is crucial to make it more stand out than the rest. Our goal is to create a card system that is not only functional, but also visually distinct. Our visual department has clear concept in the beginning: a blueprint-inspired card layout that fits the aesthetic of the game, which is sci-fi. 

We want to show that the card conveys crucial information such as Action Points (AP), card stats, and clear card description. Additionally, we wanted the visual language of the cards to be clear and reinforce each type of tank available on the battlefield. This type can be written as follows:

[olist]
[*] Assault tanks use a blue color scheme, emphasizing their offensive capabilities and frontline presence.
[*] Elemental tanks are marked with a red scheme, reflecting their high-impact, often volatile abilities that can shift the tide of battle.
[*] Utility tanks, which play a supporting role and can’t attack directly, stand apart with a green layout and expanded space for descriptions. 
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/e7d713cc3ef49d3b45aa8c07676e94e8d4ce6fba.png[/img]

After reviewing our early prototypes and gathering internal feedback, we realized the cards needed a stronger visual identity. While the first design looks solid, it is in need of better design and stronger style. Something more aligned with sci-fi theme.

Some key elements of the card had been revised for improvement. Inspired by Slay the Spire, the new card layout consists of Action Points (AP), card names, and descriptive effects. At the same time, we want to focused more on Sci-fi aesthetics. This means more cleaner UI and readable assets. We want to make sure that each tank type still maintains a distinct color identity as previous design to support quick visual recognition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/9bddda111d24c502f220e4cc7d6d5760ab43150b.png[/img]

The new iteration features a darker, moodier color palette with sharper lines and modern look. We also took the opportunity to make a gameplay improvement by reverting tank stat in the first design. During internal playtests, many players reported difficulty in identifying a tank's stats. The reasons being that they were only visible after the tank card has been deployed. With the new design, players can now assess their options more easily before making a move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/be127a3292deb86097d6d728462bd712c819d289.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/4ac607fe7eceb885ee6ee2e1d0a8e6043a1a310b.png[/img]

What do you think about the card design? don’t forget to connect with us on social media. We’re building this game with you, and your feedback makes all the difference.

notes.title: Monthly Transmission Manifest (April 2025) - Navigating The Map
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2a170c75263970abf461d05a67fa6de48aee332e.png[/img]

[h1]This is the commander speaking! [/h1]

Welcome to April devlog for Mini Tank Mayhem! For this month we’d like to keep this short as we will be describing how we overhaul our map node flow. 
 
Don’t forget to always check out our videos and posts on [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61566488172517]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/minitankmayhem/]Instagram [/url], and [url=https://x.com/MiniTankMayhem]Twitter[/url]. Now let's get those tanks moving! 

[h2]Opening The Map  [/h2]

Maps are core element shaping the whole game in general. The purpose of a map in roguelike is to bring navigation and pathway where you can go and where does it go. Our goal was to make the map expansive with branching paths. We decided to go sleek, sci-fi holographic aesthetic at first based on the theme of our game. The initial design of our map is inspired by Slay the Spire map so we embrace the fully randomized maps as in literal.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/e54646c4b928419e788ebc19d6554a27227be2b5.png[/img]

During our first private playtest, many people concerned because the flow of the map is lengthy to get to boss battle which makes them to less anticipated when reaching the boss stage. Back to design board, we simplified structure of the path and reducing branching routes. As a result, playtesters are positive to see with the changes. The second design can be seen as below where the path only breaks into 3 nodes only. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/6977e6890256ac3e21937e83717cb9808e569f0a.png[/img]

With the node issues out of the way, our logical next step is revise the map design. We wanted to make the map feels dynamic and approach like you are making progress as you start getting closer to the boss stage. We’ve drawn inspiration from Monster Train map where you descend to the abyss. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/f960f9657b9b75082bf991c4af5878ea0359e712.jpg[/img]

The final (for now) design of the map is resembles Monster Train map but you have to ascent to fight the final stage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/4ac607fe7eceb885ee6ee2e1d0a8e6043a1a310b.png[/img]

What do you think about the map node?  don’t forget to connect with us on social media. We’re building this game with you, and your feedback makes all the difference.

notes.title: Monthly Transmission Manifest (March 2025) - Switching The Canvas
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2a170c75263970abf461d05a67fa6de48aee332e.png[/img]

[h1]This is the commander speaking! [/h1]

Welcome to the March devlog for Mini Tank Mayhem! This month, we're diving into a mix of nostalgia and progress as we showcase the latest updates on the game's promotional art.  
 
Don’t forget to check out our videos and posts on [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61566488172517]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/minitankmayhem/]Instagram [/url], and [url=https://x.com/MiniTankMayhem]Twitter[/url]. Now let's get those tanks moving! 

[h2]The Old Promotional Art[/h2]

The original concept for Mini Tank Mayhem's promotional art started with a focus on highlighting both the tank and card elements, emphasizing the core mechanics of our tower defense deckbuilder. To add more context and depth, we added Aliens to give visual cue what players will be fighting against. 

As mentioned in our previous devlog, this state of visual direction is still in early phase and we lean towards cartoony yet saturated color palette.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/a5ff2eda04acb1c8e7324a3b262f79b0d4bbdf0b.png[/img]

[h2]The Second Promotional Art[/h2]

As time goes on, we've created another piece of promotional art with different approach. This time, we focused on brighter, more vibrant colors to make the visuals pop. However, we noticed that the background felt less dynamic compared to previous iterations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/f5261e97fc1c8a965d4d755bab51a6ff14e100bd.png[/img]

Back to research department, we found that many successful visuals in the genre share distinct elements such as intense action effects, swarms of enemies overwhelming the main character, and towers fiercely battling the hordes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/a6eb40e18f6f0bbd11600b1c90bda3e43340c41d.png[/img]

[h2]The Final Promotional Art[/h2]

The initial redesign is based on our first promotional art. After experimenting with different designs, we found that adding VFX, enemies, bolder colors made the art more visually striking. This new design can be an example for us as a guideline for how we approach the new promotional artwork.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mUEbtZ8.gif[/img]

The results are as follow. We created 2 instances of promotional artworks where the first art focused on multiple tanks, the second art is focused on single tank fighting the aliens. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/3fcfda46bf0d460f4869fa800619c5d6985bdf4f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/6209489d2116188e135772a2707c69adca4321a8.png[/img]

What do you think about the evolution of our promotional art? don’t forget to connect with us on social media. We’re building this game with you, and your feedback makes all the difference.

notes.title: Monthly Transmission Manifest (February 2025) - Commander Reporting For Duty
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2a170c75263970abf461d05a67fa6de48aee332e.png[/img]

[h1]This is the commander speaking! [/h1]

Welcome to February devlog for Mini Tank Mayhem! We’re kicking off this month with introducing our commander and new promotional art for Mini Tank Mayhem. We’re very excited to share this to everyone. 
 
As always, don't forget to always check out our videos and posts on [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61566488172517]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/minitankmayhem/]Instagram [/url], and [url=https://x.com/MiniTankMayhem]Twitter[/url]. Now let's get those tanks moving! 

[h2]Commander Reporting For Duty! [/h2]

In Mini Tank Mayhem, players can choose one of three commanders to aid them in battle. Each commander has their own card deck and special ability. For example, some commanders specialize in boosting tanks’ damage, while others focus on recovering missing HP from damaged tanks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/89a6c38f9b4484b350ab1f7cfa01699476a1faf4.png[/img]

Back in the brainstorming session, we initially designed two commanders: the Lieutenant and the Engineer. During development, we reached a crossroads in deciding which art style would suit the game better—Chibi or realistic proportions. After much discussion, we ultimately chose the second option. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2683fe84df6ad94b986f02bdbd8b1cd94bcfef70.png[/img]

Not all character designs were final at that stage. Once we decided on the overall art style, we refined the characters to make them cuter and more appealing. For the Engineer, we created four design variations. Each version retained key elements, such as goggles, robotic arms, and bouncy boots, ensuring a consistent identity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/dbb2940d328d61490cb438b46479d3e2ebe86ea6.png[/img]

The Lieutenant underwent notable changes, particularly in their physical and facial features. However, we retained signature elements like the jacket, beret, and a scar over one eye to maintain their established character tropes. Our goal was to make the commanders in Mini Tank Mayhem look younger and more visually appealing while still feeling battle-ready. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/5c122b4bce73bbec2baf20b962fe5904b5fda550.png[/img]

The final result is a lineup of bright and charismatic commanders, each with their own strengths. Whether you prefer an all-out offensive approach or a more tactical playstyle, the choice is yours! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/78c2ba22fbee047a34fad13baa013d95b0e1dd86.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/4ac607fe7eceb885ee6ee2e1d0a8e6043a1a310b.png[/img]

What do you think about the commanders? don’t forget to connect with us on social media. We’re building this game with you, and your feedback makes all the difference.

notes.title: Monthly Transmission Manifest (January 2025) - Placing The Cards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2a170c75263970abf461d05a67fa6de48aee332e.png[/img]

[h1]This is the commander speaking! [/h1]

Welcome to the first-ever devlog for Mini Tank Mayhem! We’re kicking off a monthly series to keep you in the loop on everything we’re working on. We’ve got some exciting updates, tweaks, and a peek behind the curtain to share with you. Let’s dive in! 

Before we dive in, don’t forget to check out our videos and posts on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. Now, let’s get those tanks rolling! 
 
[h2]
Card Design - Less Clutter, More Impact 
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/1fb9344aa3c01cc68d3384acbec999c8d62b8d48.png[/img]
We’ve been hard at work designing the card for Mini Tank Mayhem. We wanted the card design includes information that players needed and able to communicate properly. After a lot of playtesting and late-night brainstorming (maybe too much caffeine), we decided to focus on the most important details: 
[list]
[*]     Card Name 
[*]     Card Type 
[*]     Action Points (AP) 
[*]     Description 
[/list]
This simpler approach should make cards quicker to read and easier to strategize with mid-battle. Keep in mind, these designs are still evolving so your feedback could be the game-changer here! Let us know what you think about the card design. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2153b529f10cad6394e9195f9a900597bb41ad84.png[/img]

[h2]What’s Next ?
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/3b83458d16b052596557a8c846eec95fa482d908.png[/img]
We're carefully tweaking the stats and effects of each card to ensure every match feels fair. The goal is to have a balance, so no one feels overwhelmed or underpowered. We also have a fair share on polishing animations, and effects to make every more feel satisfying. But most importantly, we’re starting to work on tutorial to get new players up to speed fast.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/e16e5ea338bff4678da020904c70dd9cb3d6fbc1.png[/img]


 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/4ac607fe7eceb885ee6ee2e1d0a8e6043a1a310b.png[/img]

notes.title: Algorocks Has Released The First Trailer For Mini Tank Mayhem
notes.content:
[h1]This is the commander speaking![/h1]

First of all, [i]tank[/i] you for visiting us. At this moment, we want to announce that we finally released the first trailer of our game Mini Tank Mayhem.

The trailer, titled "Teeny Tiny Tank Teaser Trailer" (which we jokingly called the 5T) is currently available on YouTube. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=o8j8Qu9BqFw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Okay, But What’s Mini Tank Mayhem?[/h2]
For those new to our community, Mini Tank Mayhem is our take on mixing roguelike deckbuilder and Tower Defense game. In this game, you command your powerful mini-tank as you defend against relentless waves of enemies. Use your brain, collect the powerful card, and find the right combo to outgun your foes. Defend the planet from a ruthless alien invasion using a combination of strategy, creativity, and, of course, some seriously powerful cards!

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Tower Defense Meets Card Strategy: Mix and match the cards to create the ultimate strategy. From powerful artillery strikes to shockwaves, every card you play can turn the tide of battle!
[*]Roguelike Adventures: Face off against unpredictable enemy waves, gather resources, and upgrade your tank with powerful new abilities. Can you survive the ever-increasing challenge?
[*]Epic Boss Battles: Test your skills against massive, powerful bosses that will push your strategic thinking to the limit. Only the most cunning players will emerge victorious!
[*]Explosive Fun in a Tiny Tank: Don't let the size fool you—this tank packs a punch! With fast-paced gameplay, intense battles, and endless strategic possibilities, Mini Tank Mayhem offers hours of explosive fun![/list]

[h2]Okay, Now About The Trailer...[/h2]
Right! In our teaser trailer, we've shared new details of our game, including the second type of map, the boss battle, and our shop system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/e17f7cc7ceb6a95778b0d559031cf0c6598921d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/1bff532ca979a40ef732c17e6ea7086ea20d77f3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/e8e97840ed4d89289f2f6c90f36b4a8e23a409ac.jpg[/img]

The game itself is planned to be released next year. We will post various updates on our Steam page. You can expect our devlog, artwork, or tank puns here. In the future, we also plan to release a demo of the game. Please stay tuned!

[h2]Okay, This Looks Interesting[/h2]
[i]Tank[/i] you! We’re incredibly excited to have you along for the ride as we continue to develop Teeny Tiny Tank. notes.title: Mini Tank Mayhem's Steam Page Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]This is the commander speaking!
[/h1]
After months of hard work, brainstorming sessions, and countless cups of coffee, we’re thrilled to announce that Mini Tank Mayhem now has its very own Steam page! 🚀

[h2]What’s Mini Tank Mayhem?[/h2]
For those of you who are new to our community, Mini Tank Mayhem is our take on mixing roguelike deckbuilder and Tower Defense game. In this game, you command your powerful mini-tank as you defend against relentless waves of enemies. Use your brain, collect the powerful card, and find the right combo to outgun your foes. Defend the planet from a relentless alien invasion using a combination of strategy, creativity, and, of course, some seriously powerful cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/3587dee8c8a5740c6c1cbd390542268fa7508569.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/cfbb87c23b94f414f45626d94b75a871cd0ebc7b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/801e62a0a5730a06d10b7ca6591b93cba971f0f1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Tower Defense Meets Card Strategy: Mix and match the cards to create the ultimate strategy. From powerful artillery strikes to shockwaves, every card you play can turn the tide of battle!
[*]Roguelike Adventures: Face off against unpredictable enemy waves, gather resources, and upgrade your tank with powerful new abilities. Can you survive the ever-increasing challenge?
[*]Epic Boss Battles: Test your skills against massive, powerful bosses that will push your strategic thinking to the limit. Only the most cunning players will emerge victorious!
[*]Explosive Fun in a Tiny Tank: Don't let the size fool you—this tank packs a punch! With fast-paced gameplay, intense battles, and endless strategic possibilities, Mini Tank Mayhem offers hours of explosive fun![/list]

[h2]Why a Steam Page?[/h2]
First of all, we want to gather as many wishlists as we can, as soon as possible. But more than that, it’s a place where we can connect directly with you—our community. We’ll be sharing updates, development insights, and maybe even a few sneak peeks at what’s to come. 

[h2]What to Expect Next?[/h2]
Now that the Steam page is live, we’re gearing up to share even more with you. We’ll be revealing new features, showcasing gameplay footage, and diving into the nitty-gritty of what makes Mini Tank Mayhem tick. Expect regular updates on our progress, along with opportunities to get involved—whether it’s through Playtest sessions or just sharing your thoughts on our discussion boards.

[h2]Join Us on This Journey[/h2]
We’re incredibly excited to have you along for the ride as we continue to develop Mini Tank Mayhem. Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of the game as it evolves. So, head over to our Steam page, hit that “Wishlist” button, and stay tuned for more updates. See you on the battlefield!
